text.tspan: Gates validate: schema, normalized paths, personas, citation SHA-
256 freshness, no finding/severity claims. Dev and devops discovery
require the accepted partition map at the same revision; SRE
topology requires the accepted devops record (in automatic mode it
also receives the partition map as scope).

text.tspan: Automatic mode (all four gates): the same launch dispatches a real claude CLI persona call, validates the
response against the literal output schema, builds cited claims, and overwrites source_revision, target and
content_hash with orchestrator-pinned values before publish
-- no hand-authoring step. The "no" branches (produce the record, then supply_record.py) apply only in su
pplied mode, the default. Live-confirmed: D01 2026-09-24; D02-D04 2026-09-25 (SAT 20260925T170552Z,
